title: Rail sites.json
description: One entry per poker client (room or skin) Rail knows, or per network where the clients are not yet known, plus Rail's own format. docs/RAIL-PLAN.md section 3.6 and R0.12. Loaded and checked further by core/rail-config (unique ids, parser ids against the Rust registry, regular expressions). Unknown is null, never a guess.

version.description: Version of this file's shape. A downloaded file of another version is refused.

id.description: Stable key of this entry. Never reused for another client.

kind.description: room: one client a player installs (a room or a skin). network: several clients we cannot yet tell apart; a placeholder that R1.4 / R3.0 split into rooms, and that a HUD never attaches to. format: not a client at all (Rail's own text).

parser.description: Id of the rail-core parser that reads this client's files, or null when no parser exists (docs/unsupported-formats.md).

network.description: The network a room belongs to, as a label; null when none or unknown.

operating.description: Whether the client still exists: true, false (closed), null (not established by our sources).

skins.description: For a network entry: the brands it stands for, with where each name comes from in notes.

anonymisation.description: What player names in this client's files are (docs/DATABASE.md, Player identity and anonymized rooms): the site-level default of web/src/lib/db/anonymization.ts. null when no parser reads the files.

docs.description: Repository paths of the research behind this entry.

paths.description: Default hand-history folders per OS. A path names a folder: %NAME% is a Windows environment variable, ~ the home folder, * one folder level (an account name). Empty when unknown.

verified.description: true only once the folder was seen on a real install (R1.4), with checkedAt.

source.description: Where the path comes from, or how it was verified.

glob.description: File-name pattern inside a folder; null when unknown.

encoding.description: How Rail decodes the files. auto: rail-core's decode_source sniffs BOM, UTF-16 and Windows-1252 per file.

live.description: Whether the client writes hand histories to disk while you play, which a HUD needs. null when unknown.

verified.description: Whether glob and live were checked against a real install.

tables.description: What the HUD needs to find and read a table window (R3.3, R3.6, R3.11). null fields are unknown.

title.description: Regular expression (Rust regex syntax) over a table window's title, with a named group 'table' - exactly the table name the room's hands carry - and optionally 'seats' (the table size, 2-10) and 'stakes'. Captured on a real install (docs/research/CAPTURING-TABLES.md).

seatLayouts.description: Table size (2-10) to where the client draws its seats and other table graphics (R3.6), measured on a real install. A size without one gets the HUD's default geometry.

preferredSeat.description: Whether the client rotates the table so the hero always sits in one place (the layout's heroSlot). null: unknown, read as no unless the user turns it on.

verified.description: true only once the titles were seen on a real install (R3.3, docs/research/CAPTURING-TABLES.md), with checkedAt, a source and a title.

seatLayout.description: One table size's geometry in thousandths (0-1000) of the table window's client area (R3.6). The validator also checks one seat per seat of the size, heroSlot below the size and graphics inside the area.

seats.description: Each seat plate's centre [x, y], clockwise, in the order the client draws seat 1, 2, ... when it does not rotate the table.

plate.description: A seat plate's [width, height], centred on its seat.

heroSlot.description: Where a rotating client draws the hero: an index into seats.

graphics.description: Other table graphics a panel must not cover (board, pot, dealer tray, buttons), each [x, y, width, height].

seatNumbers.description: The hand history's seat number of each entry of seats, when it is not 1..size; null: 1..size.

hud.description: The room's HUD policy. allowed: true only after R3.0's dated, sourced check; false prohibited; null unknown, which the HUD treats as prohibited (guideline section 7).

hudRestrictions.description: What a permitted room's policy forbids the HUD to show or do (R3.4; docs/research/HUD-POLICIES.md). Each field restricts when true (or a number); the HUD's renderer enforces them, and a downloaded file can only add restrictions.

ownHandsOnly.description: Statistics only from hands the user played.

rawCountsOnly.description: Raw counts over opportunities, nothing adjusted by population tendencies.

maxColourThresholds.description: At most this many fixed colour thresholds per statistic; null: the statistic's own bands.

noCardSplitStats.description: No statistic split by card values.

noGameStateSwitching.description: The display does not switch with position, stacks or other game state.

noTendencySwitching.description: The display does not switch with the opponent's tendencies.

noPlayerLabels.description: No rating, labelling or categorising of players.

noGraphs.description: No graph of more than one data point.

noHandInPlay.description: Nothing from the hand in play.

noOverlapTableGraphics.description: Panels never overlap the client's own table graphics.
